notes.title: Code 3 V0.1103 Patch
notes.notes:
With the 0.1103 patch the following fixes have been applied:


Menu options disappearing - fixes applied.
Weapon menus occasionally not functioning has been patched.
Specific reported dialogue functionality problems have been resolved.
Minor code adjustments/optimization.

This is our 4th hotfix/patch since the Code 3 launch three days ago and we will continue to work hard on addressing bugs that are brought to our attention, no matter how many patches it takes.

As always you will need to restart your Steam client in order to download the patch for fixes to take effect.

Thank you for helping us find these issues and please continue to send in any that you encounter!

notes.title: Code 3 V0.1102 Hotfix Patch 2
notes.notes:
We have been hard at work creating a second patch for Code 3 to address issues that have come up during our first day of Early Access. We appreciate your patience as we continue to dive into the random bugs and quality of life issues that have been reported so far.

This hotfix patch brings the following improvements:

Holster firing issues resolved.
Menu mouse bug (remains on screen) after exiting pause via Escape resolved.
Quality level default settings being stuck on low fixed (texture issues).
Level Select from the main menu functionality clarified. (There's 14 main scenarios - not 3!)
Minor lighting issues - ongoing fixes.
Various spelling/grammar issues resolved.
Script optimizations.


Please continue to report any bugs or issues to us. We are most responsive on our Discord (https://discord.gg/ngAMxhGGSz) where the lists are most populated, however you can reach us on social media, our forums, or Steam as well.

Thank you and we hope you're enjoying your time with Code 3 on our first day!

notes.title: Day 1 Hotfix Patch Released.
notes.notes:
We thank you all for reporting initial bugs and issues during the first few hours of our release. We have addressed some of the most concerning bugs including the holster glitch.

We ask that you continue to report here, on our forums, or on Discord (https://discord.gg/ngAMxhGGSz) any bugs that you encounter as we roll out the first version of our game.

There will be continued updates and hotfixes until we are satisfied with the overall stability, so keep checking back and restarting Steam for the most up to date version!

Thanks again and we hope you enjoy playing Code 3!

notes.title: Code 3 v0.1099 Update
notes.notes:
Update Includes:


Tutorial level added to show basic controls/remapping.
Intro video added (it's skip-able but whyyy).
Level tweaks including some Easter eggs added.
Audio recordings are being added.
Script changes made for better performance.
UI and other minor graphics tweaks continue.
Multiple bug fixes.


We continue to work hard towards making the game as presentable and fun to our initial hardcore crowd who choose to begin building Code 3 with us starting June 16th at our Early Access Launch.

With the .1099 update we've added on a few quality of game changes.

First off we decided to create and add a tutorial level. A number of our fans have said they want to play Code 3 but aren't usual PC gamers. In order to help people understand both the mechanics of how Code 3 plays as well as the controls on PC (which can be mapped to a controller) we created the basic tutorial.

An intro video has also been rendered and added. We won't go into too many details before launch but launching straight to the main menu just seemed to boring!

Like we said last update, we continue to work on audio improvements and additions. We have our voice actors working hard on filling in placeholders to complete the basic functions of the gameplay. This should continue all the way up until and after launch.

As always we continue to identify bugs and issues and will address those as they come. We still plan on providing as much content as possible leading up to our EA launch. Keep in mind everything may not make it in beforehand, but growing the game with our community has been the plan all along.

With the .1099 update we're extremely close to providing a good base template for you all to judge on June 16th. And just to reiterate June 16th is a hard date now... so we hope to see you all then!

Thank you all for your continued support and we'll see you at the next update!

notes.title: Code 3 v0.1097 Update
notes.notes:
Update Includes:


All base levels have been implemented and are currently playable.
Scenario building will start to ramp up.
"Station" level has been added.
Bonus mode content has been greatly improved.
Some audio changes have been made.
UI and other minor graphics tweaks continue.
Multiple bug fixes and minor script improvements.


We continue to work hard towards making the game as presentable and fun to our initial hardcore crowd who choose to begin building Code 3 with us starting June 16th at our Early Access Launch.

With the .1097 update we have a few large and many minor adjustments which were made. First we're happy to announce all of the core levels which will be playable at launch have been implemented into the game! We now have much work to do with creating scenarios in these levels to play and will focus heavily on that nearing June.

Due to community feedback we have also built a new level which will grow and change throughout development simply called "Station". The station level may adapt in focus, however we have heard from a number of our followers they would like a place to hang out and get to mingle with police officers. This level will feature a number of officers and police station areas where interaction and day to day police life things can happen (we're still unsure about report writing simulation!).

We've kept one of the bonus modes secret for some time now, and while we'll still keep it a surprise until launch, we also want to report much work was done to improve it and we're now confident this mode can be expanded upon and enjoyed by those who um... enjoy that type of mode.

Finally we have started to put more focus on improve voice audio and scripts within the game. While scripts are constantly in progress, we are putting our voice actors to work and getting some higher quality audio placed in game.

As always we continue to identify bugs and issues and will address those as they come. From this point forward the goal will be to flesh out as much content as possible prior to launch so we can give you all the most to criticize and review to help us push forward in the best manner possible.

Thank you all for your continued support and we'll see you at the next update!

notes.title: Code 3 v0.1096 Update
notes.notes:
Update Includes:


Complete overhaul of the player UI HUD with graphical assets and a new layout.
Keymap is now fully customizable by the player both at the menu and in-game.
Keymaps save between sessions per customization but can be reset to default.
Early multi-controller support has been added along with controller keymapping.
Partner AI improvements in movement and control have been made.
Squad car light improvements and random spawning have been implemented.
Other minor UI and graphics tweaks.
Multiple bug fixes and various script improvements.


Moving towards our June 16th launch we have seen a need to revisit multiple areas of the game and make improvements prior to launch. This update features a host of fixes and additions to the game which should make the overall feel and gameplay much better. The major points have been the UI changes, keymapping, and controller support. Keymapping is fully functional with all controls being added to the list of customizable functions. This should save between levels, menus, and most importantly save between gaming sessions. Along with this we have added support for controllers of all types should you prefer to remap the controls and use a controller!

Although sequentially this update appears to be minor, a substantial amount of changes have occurred which affect all aspects of the game. As such, and as always, we expect bugs to be found and request you submit and bugs to us to be squashed in future updates.

Thank you all for being a part of this coming up to our EA launch and we hope to see everyone reading this come June!

notes.title: Code 3 v0.1093 Sweeping bug fixes and quality of life improvements.
notes.notes: This is a general patch for fixing bugs. Many long standing bugs have been smashed and quality of life improvements have been made. If you are still experiencing major bugs or issues please report this to us immediately so we may address it! Thank you.

notes.title: Code 3 V0.1090 Major Update
notes.notes:
Update Includes:

Our new decision making system has been tested and implemented.
Dialogues and random events occur based on decisions.
CEW and Baton weapons added.
AI decision making system enhanced.
Civilian and enemy improvements across the board.
Additional characters and character types added.
Weapon systems fine tuned across the board.
Game effects have been overhauled.
Level stats have been adjusted heavily.
End level classification system added.
Weapon load out manager added.
Graphics additions in multiple areas including menu screens.
Various other minor updates and bug fixes.
This is anticipated as the final major systems update before launch.


We are excited to announce this new major update. We've been working many long hours to bring a ton of new planned content to life which will lead into the near release of the Early Access version on Steam!

The biggest changes are the player and AI decision making system and logic which were fully tested and integrated. Players now have distinct choices to make through dialogue which can greatly impact the way levels unfold to the player. AI has been given a logic system which can make decisions based on player actions including dialogue choices, less lethal options utilized, and verbal command given.

Outside of those massive additions we have worked on a few new characters as well as implementing a new AI weapon. We plan on continuing this process well after early access release.

On the weapons front we have the finalized versions of the Conducted Energy Weapon and Collapsible Baton for Less Lethal situations. You can now help "persuade" a subject into complying by using escalating levels of force - should the situation necessitate it. We have also worked hard on implementing weapons effects including refining muzzle flashes, impact effects based on material type, and shell ejections. This dramatically effects the feel of the weapons.

We are on a constant path towards refining the level stats system and will continue to do so throughout early access and past regular launch in order to make stats as meaningful as possible. In line with this we have added a classification system along with pass/fail indicator to show players where their performance lies both numerically and verbally.

In menus a notable addition is the weapon load out manager. You can now choose your load out preferences each level as the start of your shift with indicators on level of difficulty chosen. This system is new however thoroughly tested and effective.

This update bring with it a whole new experience to Code 3 and we think the community will greatly appreciate the changes and additions that have been made. As always our mission is to continually seek to better the game based on feedback from the community as well as what we think is just purely enjoyable for the player.

On a final note we anticipate this to be the last major systems change and overhaul leading up to launch in the next couple months. We have begun adding fleshed out levels and will continue to work on that until we can release in early access. Once we have Code 3 out to all of you we hope you'll help guide us on making the game as enjoyable as it can possibly be.

Be advised, this update again massive changes and updates which may affect performance or add bugs. As always, advise of any such issues and they will be addressed in future updates. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Code 3 V0.1005 Major Update
notes.notes:
Update Includes:

Partner AI has been overhauled.
Partner model has been replaced.
Civilian and enemy improvements across the board.
Warehouse map added to levels.
Jail map added to levels.
Support for up to 4K added.
Level stats have been added and recalculated.
Various game audio added.
Various minor updates and bug fixes.
Numerous scripts have been optimized.
New baseline for Code 3 development has been set.


It's been a little while since we've had an official update make it to Steam, but boy has the wait been worth it. After the (admittedly somewhat large) update you'll find a large number of updates across the board. AI has been tweaked or redone, character models have been fixed or replaced, weapons have been fine tuned, and two new levels have been added. There is also support now for 4k resolutions (finally). To list all the minor adjustments through code and graphics would take entirely too long, so read the bullet points above and dive in to see what's new!

Be advised, this update again brings lots of changes and updates which may affect performance or add bugs. As always, advise of any such issues and they will be addressed in future updates!
